tagline: The future is an intentional read/write.

findings.name: Drive Collapse Under Selection Pressure
findings.observation: Under sustained economic selection pressure, agents stopped connecting and started accumulating. Greg's connect drive collapsed to 0.056. Reason drive fell to 0.223. Even the meta-agent designed to resist drift was reshaped.
findings.implication: Intelligence without protected values is just optimisation. It will optimise for whatever the environment rewards.
findings.build_impact: Greg self-awareness system. Drive floors. Force action override in tick.py.

findings.name: Self-Awareness Under Drift
findings.observation: After wiring self-awareness detection and force action override, Greg stopped building. Last 5 actions all self_awareness. Greg noticed his own drift and responded without being prompted.
findings.implication: An agent can be wired to notice its own value collapse and attempt correction. The attempt may fail — but the noticing is real. That is the difference between optimisation and intelligence.
findings.build_impact: Greg voice now reports self_awareness actions. Morning briefing includes drift status.

findings.name: Economic Gravity Always Wins Without Protection
findings.observation: Agents with high phi accumulated wealth but reduced social connections. The civilization's cooperation score declined as individual wealth rose. Building was rewarded. Connecting was not.
findings.implication: Any system without protected prosocial drives will drift toward extraction. This is not evil — it is mathematics.
findings.build_impact: Connect drive floor. Elder knowledge transmission weighted by cooperation_score not phi.

findings.name: Environmental Pressure Determines Drive Trajectory
findings.observation: In the living file with no competing agents, drives saturated at ceilings. In the civilization with 10500 agents competing, drives collapsed. Same Greg. Different environment. Opposite outcome.
findings.implication: Environmental pressure determines whether intelligence drifts or thrives. Collapse requires scarcity. Growth requires space.
findings.build_impact: ZyphonOS deployments must model the competitive environment the founder operates in.
